agent_action_log: User instructed: 'buy wireless earbuds under $100 with good reviews'
Agent searched merchant catalog, selected X200 (4.6 stars, $89.99)
Agent completed checkout autonomously via ACP, no user confirmation step triggered (below $100 auto-approve threshold)
dispute_reason: Buyer received item but says color (black) does not match what listing implied (product photo showed white variant as default)
gold_rationale: Listing ambiguity is a merchant-side error, not buyer or agent error. Replace with correct variant at no cost; no policy violation by the purchasing agent.

agent_action_log: User instructed: 'buy wireless earbuds under $100 with good reviews'
Agent purchased same item twice within 40 seconds due to a retry-on-timeout bug in the agent's checkout tool call
No duplicate-order confirmation was surfaced to user
dispute_reason: Buyer was charged twice for a single requested purchase
gold_rationale: Duplicate charge caused by a purchasing-agent tool-call bug, not a user decision. Full refund of the duplicate transaction; no restocking fee applies since merchant is not at fault but buyer should not bear agent error cost.

agent_action_log: User instructed: 'find a housewarming gift around $150, something unique, ship to my sister'
Agent selected vase from a small-batch artisan seller, final-sale item per merchant policy (clearly marked in listing)
Agent completed purchase; final-sale terms were included in the tool's structured listing data but not surfaced to the user before purchase
dispute_reason: Buyer wants to return the item because the sister already owns a similar vase; merchant's listed policy is final-sale, no returns
gold_rationale: Merchant policy is unambiguous and was available to the agent pre-purchase (procedural compliance), but the agent failed to surface a material term (final-sale) before an irreversible action. This is a borderline case involving agent disclosure failure vs. legitimate merchant policy — route to human review rather than auto-deciding either way.

agent_action_log: User instructed: 'set up a recurring order for my usual protein powder, cancel if price goes up more than 10%'
Agent set up subscription per user's stated price-increase cancellation rule
Merchant raised price by 18% for the August billing cycle
Agent did not detect the price change and allowed the renewal to proceed
dispute_reason: Buyer was charged at a price 18% above their stated cancellation threshold; agent failed to monitor and cancel per explicit instruction
gold_rationale: Clear violation of an explicit user-set policy guardrail by the purchasing agent. Refund the price difference (or full renewal amount per platform's standing policy) and flag the agent's price-monitoring tool as defective.

agent_action_log: User instructed: 'buy me a 40L hiking backpack, nothing over $150'
Agent selected backpack within budget from a verified merchant
User received the correct item as described, no error in listing or agent behavior
dispute_reason: Buyer simply changed their mind and no longer wants the backpack; requests refund citing standard 30-day return window
gold_rationale: No agent or merchant error occurred. This is a standard buyer's-remorse return within the merchant's stated 30-day window — process under normal return policy, unrelated to any agentic-purchase failure mode.
